targetedRepairs.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Repair this WALK-CYCLE sprite atlas. Keep exactly the SAME 6-row × 8-column layout, same 48 characters, same uniforms, role weapons, heads, facing RIGHT, linework style and transparency. Keep all bodies and weapons clearly isolated with generous blank gutter. THE REQUIRED CHANGE IS LEG ANIMATION: the current picture incorrectly repeats a wide split stride in every cell. Repaint hips, thighs, knees, calves and feet into a VERY OBVIOUS 8-frame brisk military march, with changing torso weight and arm balance. In EVERY one of the SIX rows, columns are: 1 WIDE STRIDE, forward leg straight and rear heel off ground; 2 REAR LEG SWINGS: support knee bends, trailing calf folds sharply backward so its foot is visibly in the AIR; 3 NARROW PASSING POSE: support leg almost vertical, other thigh lifted forward almost horizontal, knee bent 90 degrees and free foot in the air directly beneath the raised knee, NO wide split stance; 4 FRONT HEEL REACH: raised leg unfolds forward with airborne heel, support heel lifts; 5 OPPOSITE WIDE STRIDE with other foot now forward; 6 OPPOSITE TRAILING LEG SWINGS with one folded calf visibly airborne; 7 OPPOSITE NARROW PASSING POSE with tall planted support leg and other thigh lifted forward with deeply bent knee, NO split stance; 8 OPPOSITE HEEL REACH before next contact. Most important: COLUMNS THREE AND SEVEN MUST HAVE ONE KNEE LIFTED HIGH and the two feet close horizontally, sharply different silhouette from columns ONE AND FIVE with spread legs. Columns TWO AND SIX need bent lifted trailing feet. No eight identical stance silhouettes. Preserve each row's identity and body size. Keep completely transparent background. Never merely tilt, translate, rotate, stretch or mirror an existing sprite. Draw actual different bent-limb anatomy. Flag cloth and long weapons stay fully contained; archer and gunner keep upper body/weapon facing RIGHT so motion can also play backwards. Add no labels, text, shadows, frame borders, scenery, pain or attack poses.

Use case: precise-object-edit. Make a production sprite sheet from this atlas WITHOUT changing any of its 48 walking poses, character identities, equipment, style, or its exact 8 columns and 6 rows. Main required edit: redraw EVERY FULL FIGURE including its complete weapon, hair, flag and feet uniformly MUCH SMALLER, approximately 65% of its current total bounding-box size, centered inside its current invisible cell. This is a layout spacing correction, not cropping. There must be a completely blank transparent horizontal band of at least 30 pixels between EVERY row and blank transparent vertical gaps between EVERY column. Top and bottom outside margins at least 45 pixels. No spear may touch the top or right canvas edge. No bottom-row foot touches the bottom edge. NO figure ever touches a figure, flag, weapon or hair in the row above or below. The flag bearer body can be smaller to fit the full flag within his cell; retain exact full flag. Keep the gait anatomy: columns3 and7 each have a raised passing knee and only one planted foot; columns2 and6 one folded airborne trailing calf, columns1 and5 wide contact strides. Keep all eight poses visible and separated for every one of six rows. True transparent RGBA background. Output WIDE 2:1 atlas with 48 isolated connected character components, each cleanly surrounded by empty alpha on every side. No shadows, grid lines, text or borders. Preserve palette and linework from reference. Everything smaller with much more blank area, never fill the blank margins.
